title: drupilot PHP polyfills (config/php/polyfills.json)
description: The functions each symfony/polyfill-phpXY package a Drupal core release can require defines, at the lowest version core requires. Only the unconditional functions are counted on (scripts/lib/plan.sh core_range_polyfills).

php.description: The PHP version whose functions the package provides below it.

min_version.description: The lowest package version a Drupal core release requires (its bootstrap was read at that tag).

functions.description: Defined unconditionally on every PHP below php.

conditional.description: Defined only when an extension core does not require is loaded: never counted on.
